rationale: Austral Construction is a direct employer seeking Project Engineers for a Pilbara FIFO 2/1 roster earthworks pipeline.
Experience is only stated as "preferably a minimum of 3 years", a softened preference rather than a hard requirement.
Earthworks discipline overlaps Marc's Advanced Diploma; his recorded FIFO availability is specifically Central QLD, not WA.
caution: "Preferably" 3 years' site experience is a strong preference in practice, and FIFO availability is only on record for Central Queensland, not WA.
apply_instructions: Apply via SEEK with a CV detailing suitability; medical, online tests and inductions required if successful.
title: Project Engineers - Civil
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a Civil Project Engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Have you completed a qualification in civil engineering?
Are you available to work FIFO / DIDO contracts?
